ITEM 1 | Pale green cucumber-like slices, thin half-moon pieces about 0.5 cm thick and 3-4 cm long, with darker green skin edges and pale translucent flesh, slightly glossy and moist, arranged in a loose cluster at the upper left of the plate | 45
ITEM 2 | Thin, bright green long beans, cut to roughly 6-8 cm lengths, slightly glossy with a fresh, firm texture, piled in a loose diagonal bundle across the center-right of the plate | 75
ITEM 3 | Browned meat slices, two pieces of seared tan-to-brown meat with darker caramelized edges and a fibrous grain, the larger piece about 6 cm long and 1.5 cm thick, the smaller about 4 cm long and 1 cm thick, lying beside the green beans on the left | 50
ITEM 4 | Golden-brown baked portion with crisp, bumpy, uneven crust showing flecks of green herbs, about 7 cm by 6 cm and roughly 2.5 cm high, slightly crumbly and flaky on the surface, sitting at the right edge of the plate | 110
